mentions.name: WhoThatFace
mentions.description: Facial identification and recognition system that lets families and groups share training data to make it easier to assign faces to known people. Face assignment in a single location currently works, though clustering sometimes struggles to differentiate related family members. Planned phases include a non-technical interface for reviewing and assigning faces, a clear client/server split, and cross-platform client support.
mentions.audience: Families and groups sharing training data
mentions.source_excerpt: Using AI to build a Facial identification / recognition system (https://github.com/weisnobody/WhoThatFace)  that will allow families / groups to share the training data to make it easier to assign faces to known people.  Single location is currently working but it sometimes has trouble differentiating related family member during the clustering stage.
mentions.author: weisnobody
